definitions.gloss: neologism; newly coined word; new coinage
definitions.explanation: A word that has been recently created or invented, either by combining existing elements in a new way or by introducing an entirely new term. Used in linguistic and media discussions about language evolution.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{言葉|ことば}→言葉：02880_kotoba⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{最近|さいきん}→最近：00881_saikin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{新造語|しんぞうご}だ。
examples.english: This word is a recent neologism.

examples.japanese: SNS⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{普及|ふきゅう}→普及：07592_fukyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{新造語|しんぞうご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{次々|つぎつぎ}→次々：03522_tsugitsugi⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{生|う}まれている→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧。
examples.english: With the spread of social media, new coinages are being born one after another.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{編集者|へんしゅうしゃ}→編集者：09587_henshuusha⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧{新造語|しんぞうご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧、⟦{掲載|けいさい}する→掲載する：19217_keisaisuru⟧⟦かどうか→かどうか：28299_kadouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: Dictionary editors survey neologisms every year and decide whether to include them.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{新造|しんぞう}→新造：26611_shinzou⟧ (newly made) and ⟦{語|ご}→〜語：09841_go⟧ (word). Japanese has a rich tradition of word creation, particularly through combining kanji compounds, borrowing from English (wasei-eigo), and blending elements from multiple languages.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {新造語|しんぞうご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to coin a new word
- {新造語|しんぞうご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定着|ていちゃく}→定着：07594_teichaku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: for a neologism to become established
- {新造語|しんぞうご}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{生|う}まれる→生まれる：00905_umareru⟧: for a neologism to emerge

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{造語|ぞうご}→造語：25313_zougo⟧: coined word — a broader term that includes any artificially created word regardless of when it was coined
- ⟦{新語|しんご}→新語：21555_shingo⟧: new word — a word that has recently entered the language, whether coined or borrowed
- ⟦{流行語|りゅうこうご}→流行語：13307_ryuukougo⟧: buzzword, trendy expression — a word or phrase that is currently popular, but may not be newly created
